svg.title: Two models explain distinct sources of unused capacity
svg.text: Two models explain distinct sources of unused capacity
Grid supply: hypothetical 16 block slots, each block takes 10 μs
16 blocks fill one wave; 17 blocks need a partial second wave in this idealized model.
Readiness: one issue/cycle, four-cycle dependent instruction spacing
One warp issues at 0, 4, 8, 12. Four independent ready warps fill cycles 0 through 15.
A common dependency can block every resident warp
More resident state does not resolve the producer dependency or shorten the pending result delay.
These are arithmetic models, not observed GPU schedules or clock specifications.
Whole-window occupancy ratios and profiler active-cycle metrics may use different denominators.
